# IdleManager

> **File:** `services/session/IdleManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Idle: what happens when you step away (the Idle section), run by the axiom daemon (idle.state: docs/dev/features/idle.md), and the caffeine switch that keeps the session awake. The Wayland idle inhibitor itself needs a mapped surface, so shell/IdleInhibit holds one while `caffeine` is on; the daemon is told too, as notifications that ignore inhibitors (Idle.respectInhibitors off) would ignore that surface. Caffeine is kept across QML reloads, but a restart always starts with idle allowed. Created from shell.qml's `_services`. axiom ipc idleInhibit toggle

### Properties

- `caffeine` (alias)
- `status` (readonly string): "off" | "running" | "inhibited" (an app holds idle off) | "unsupported" (the compositor has no idle notifications) | "unavailable" (no daemon to run it)
- `inhibitors` (readonly var): What holds idle off: [{ source: "screensaver" | "logind" | "caffeine", app, reason }]
- `screensaverHolder` (readonly string): The program holding org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver instead of axiom, "" when axiom or the compositor (which applies them itself) does: apps asking it to keep the screen on aren't seen

### Functions

- `toggle()`
